sandbachFocus: Sandbach United's home fixture against Eccleshall on Saturday has already been played, with Sandbach securing a 1-0 victory at Sandbach Community Football Centre. Josh Fowles opened the scoring early in the match, and despite Eccleshall applying significant second-half pressure—including a shot that struck the crossbar—Sandbach held firm to claim three points. This win extends their unbeaten run and strengthens their position in the title race alongside Stafford Town and AFC Bridgnorth, all on 19 points.
divisionWide: The title race remains incredibly tight at the top, with three clubs locked on 19 points after Saturday's results. AFC Bridgnorth were not in action this week and maintain their unbeaten record (6W-1D from 7 games). Stafford Town drew 2-2 away at Cheadle Heath Nomads after going down to 10 men, dropping points in a dramatic encounter. Below the top three, Eccleshall's defeat to Sandbach keeps them fourth on 18 points with a strong 4-game winning streak now halted. Bilston Town dominated Market Drayton Town 3-0 at home, with Market Drayton reduced to 10 men early on and Bilston capitalizing through goals from Dixon, Crump, and Bustin. New Mills fell 2-1 at home to Dawley Town despite equalizing through Will Frankish. Wolverhampton Casuals secured an impressive 3-1 victory away at Shawbury United, recovering from 1-0 down to dominate the second half with goals from McIntosh, Podmore, and Cook from the penalty spot. Barnton claimed a crucial 1-0 away win at Telford Town late in the second half. Allscott Heath thrashed struggling Alsager Town 3-1 at home after Alsager had taken an early lead, with Allscott scoring through Allen, Parkinson, and Newnes. Brereton Social secured a 1-0 home lead against AFC Bridgnorth through an own goal on 26 minutes, with the match still ongoing at the time of these updates. Crewe hosted Wednesfield Community, and Foley Meir prepared to host Widnes Town, though full match reports for these fixtures were not available in the provided updates.
